message:
I remember one winter when the snow piled up so high, it looked like the world had been dipped in powdered sugar. My grandkids were ecstatic, and I thought, why not make the most of it? We gathered blankets, made some hot chocolate, and settled in for a movie marathon right by the window. 

While the wind howled outside, we turned our little living room into a cozy fort of warmth and laughter. It struck me how a storm can be less of a nuisance and more of an opportunity for togetherness. 

So, when the forecast calls for a weather event, I like to think of it as a chance to create a snug little adventure. What’s your go-to cozy activity when the weather turns wild? ☕
